# Website FAQ & Lead Capture Agent

> A chat box for a local service business’s own website that answers visitor questions from the business’s own hours, prices, and services, and captures a name and number when it cannot answer. $49 flat, one payment, no monthly fee.

Website FAQ & Lead Capture Agent is a product by Northbeam Builds, a small studio in Austin, TX that builds websites and AI tools for local service businesses. Company site: https://northbeambuilds.com

## What it is

Website FAQ & Lead Capture Agent — for shop owners whose website can’t answer a single question: it’s a chat box on your site that answers from your own hours, prices, and services, and takes a name and number when it can’t answer, so visitors become leads instead of leaving.

## Who it is for

For: Your shop has a website that just sits there.; You’re tired of answering the same five questions.; You’re losing evening and weekend visitors who never call.
Not for: You don’t have a website yet — start with Website + Online Booking.; You need a bigger question set, with conversations built around your business.

## Price

$49 flat — one payment, no monthly fee. (Regular price $149.) Live on your site as described, or your $49 comes back in full — guaranteed.
Buy online (Stripe checkout): https://buy.stripe.com/aFa4gz04s19ifIS3J4gYU01
Before you pay: this agent runs on hosting we are still standing up, so it cannot go live yet and the go-live clock has not started. Once the hosting is in place, the clock runs exactly as stated on this page.

## How it works

1. A visitor lands on your website with a question — hours, prices, what you fix.
2. The chat box answers right away, using your own business info. If the answer isn’t there, the box says so and takes a message instead of guessing.
3. If it can’t answer, it asks for a name and number — and the lead is saved for you in your lead view.

## What is included

- The chat box set up on your website.
- Answers built from your own pages and info.
- Lead capture with name and number.
- Every lead in your private lead view right away; optional push to a webhook you control, or email via your own mail relay, arranged at setup.
- Live 1 business day after payment, your content, and site access are all in — whichever comes last starts the clock.
- Live on your site as described, or your $49 comes back in full — guaranteed.

## Questions and answers

- Q: Where do the answers come from?
  A: Your own website and the info you give us — your hours, prices, services, and service area. If the answer isn’t there, the box says so and takes a message instead of guessing.
- Q: What happens when it can’t answer?
  A: It asks for a name and number. Every lead lands in your private lead view right away; an optional push to a webhook you control, or email via your own mail relay, can be arranged at setup.
- Q: Does it work on my kind of website?
  A: Almost always. If your site can carry a small chat box, we can set it up. We’ll tell you before you pay if yours can’t.
- Q: Is there a monthly fee?
  A: No. $49 once. That’s it.
- Q: What does the FAQ Agent do for a plumbing shop?
  A: It answers the questions a plumbing site gets every week — hours, service area, what the shop fixes, and any published prices — from the shop's own info, and takes a name and number when it cannot answer. See https://faqagent.northbeambuilds.com/for-plumbers/
- Q: What does the FAQ Agent do for an HVAC company?
  A: It answers the questions an HVAC site gets every week — hours, service area, what the company services, and any published prices — from the company’s own info, and takes a name and number when it cannot answer. See https://faqagent.northbeambuilds.com/for-hvac/
- Q: What does the FAQ Agent do for a roofing company?
  A: It answers the questions a roofing site gets every week — hours, service area, what the company does, and any published prices — from the company’s own info, and takes a name and number when it cannot answer. See https://faqagent.northbeambuilds.com/for-roofers/
- Q: What does the FAQ Agent do for an electrical company?
  A: It answers the questions an electrical site gets every week — hours, service area, what the company repairs and installs, and any published prices — from the company’s own info, and takes a name and number when it cannot answer. See https://faqagent.northbeambuilds.com/for-electricians/
